Keep in good sanitary conditions and in a dry, fresh air, at a temperature of about 20°C, keeping the can strictly closed. Utilizzabile anche per l’aerografo.  Prodotto   non   atto   al   consumo   diretto   ma esclusivamente destinato ad uso professionale.  Food   Liposoluble   liquid   color   for   decoration   and coatings.  It could be used also for the airbrush.  Product not qualified to the direct use but exclusively directed to professional use.  ISTRUZIONI D’USO / APPLICATION  Agitare accuratamente il contenitore prim a dell’uso.  Da utilizzare solo in opportune diluizioni,   secondo  buone norme dettate da competenza dell’operatore  professionale.  Shake carefully the container before use. Only use in proper dilution, following good norms suggested by the professional operator.
